\begin{lexlean}{Main}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
inductive{
  name: Expr,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  constructors: [
    {name: ELit, fields: [Nat, Nat]},
    {name: ERead, fields: [Nat, Nat, Nat]},
    {name: ENil, fields: []},
    {name: ECons, fields: [Expr, Expr]}
  ]
}

definition{
  name: itemTail,
  parameters: [items : Expr],
  result: Expr,
  body: (match items
    | Expr.ELit v0 v1 => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ERead v0 v1 v2 => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ENil => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ECons item itemsTail => itemsTail),
  executable: true
}

definition{
  name: itemHead,
  parameters: [items : Expr],
  result: Expr,
  body: (match items
    | Expr.ELit v0 v1 => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ERead v0 v1 v2 => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ENil => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ECons item itemsTail => item),
  executable: true
}

definition{
  name: bumpedTail,
  parameters: [items : Expr],
  result: Expr,
  body: (match items
    | Expr.ELit v0 v1 => (ctor Expr.ELit (v0 + 1) v1)
    | Expr.ERead v0 v1 v2 => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ENil => (ctor Expr.ENil)
    | Expr.ECons item itemsTail => itemsTail),
  executable: true
}

definition{
  name: tailOf,
  parameters: [items : Expr],
  result: Expr,
  body: (bumpedTail (itemHead (itemTail items))),
  production: {effects: [allocation, overflow, recursion], targets: [rust-std]},
  executable: true
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
